evidence.reason: Lines 1287 and 1292 leave `launched` as None when `boot()` raises before returning launch info; the exception path at 1300-1302 then calls `stop_owned_process(..., launched=None)` after `run_lock` has been released. That is the unguarded caller-side cleanup: a concurrent retry can acquire the lock and launch, and the failed caller can stop that VM because it has no PID/start-time identity to scope the stop. The comment at line 1293 also states that later cleanup must stop only this launch. This is an ordinary concurrency/cleanup defect in existing intended behavior, not a request for a new requirement.
